# Let's extract the songs that are missing the release month (those with RELEASED_AT TODO).
# We'll need to get the release month for each of these songs from Spotify.
import re

note_content = note_details["content"]
# Find all lines with RELEASED_AT TODO
todo_lines = [line for line in note_content.split('\n') if "RELEASED_AT TODO" in line]
# Extract song titles and artists
todo_songs = []
for line in todo_lines:
    # Example: "- Silver Lining BY Ava Morgan RELEASED_AT TODO"
    match = re.match(r"- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT TODO", line)
    if match:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        artist = match.group(2).strip()
        todo_songs.append({"title": title, "artist": artist})
print(todo_songs)
